name: plaro
description: Your project's agreed requirements and what changed, from Plaro: tools to read them, change notices when you send a message, the commands plan_changes · plan_project · check_acceptance, and — each call approved by you — questions for the PM, what was built, and (on your own Plaro account) passed acceptance checks.
